content:
deploybot: AUTO-ROLLBACK SUGGESTED: embeddings-dedicated v3.2.1 p95 latency > 1200ms (threshold 700ms) for EU pool. Auto-revert window in 5m unless suppressed.

jana: suppressing auto-rollback for now — want manual targeted rollback to EU-dedicated only. need to avoid disturbing US customers.

sam: +1 on targeted rollback. can we confirm spike correlates with the new KV-cache kernel flag?

lia: checking traces — yes, increased kv-cache miss rate on nodes running v3.2.1 in eu-west-1. Canary nodes also show degraded tail latency but stable qps.

ops-bot: commit: 7f3a9c1 (v3.2.1). Compatible fallback: v3.2.0 (commit: e2b7d4a). Rollback command (target pool eu-dedicated):

```
# rollout rollback --scope=pool:eu-dedicated --from=7f3a9c1 --to=e2b7d4a --strategy=staggered --drain=true
```

maria: assign customer comms — i'll draft a short note for customers on EU dedicated saying we're rolling back a perf change; ETA ~15m.

kevin: i'll run the rollback. jana, confirm go and who owns postmortem?

jana: go for kevin to execute. sam to run quick validation checks after rollback. i'll own the postmortem ticket (ENG-ROLLBACK-1532).

deploybot: Suppression confirmed by jana. Auto-rollback cancelled. Manual rollback window remains open.

kevin: executing now — starting staggered rollout to eu-dedicated. Will stream status updates.

kevin: step 1/4: pausing new traffic to batch-1 nodes.

lia: seeing initial drop in p95 on one node within 60s.

kevin: step 2/4: applying v3.2.0 to batch-1.

kevin: step 3/4: draining held connections.

sam: running smoke tests against embeddings route (eu) — simple embed call, 10qps for 30s.

sam: results: success, p95 back to ~420ms. no errors.

kevin: step 4/4: finishing rollout to remaining nodes in pool. All nodes now at v3.2.0.

ops-bot: rollback complete for pool eu-dedicated. duration: 8m. Incident tag: rollback-eu-6112223334.

maria: published customer note to the EU dedicated customers list. Subject: "Temporary rollback: embeddings perf update". Also updated release notes (unreleased) to mark v3.2.1 as rolled back for eu-dedicated.

jana: great work. action items:
- sam: add telemetry snippet to ENG-ROLLBACK-1532 (kv-cache misses + kernel flag)
- kevin: attach exact commands run and timing
- lia: collect traces for first 15m of the spike
- maria: share comm thread link in the ticket

sam: on it. adding graphs and short summary.

kevin: added command logs and timestamps to the ticket. also pinned v3.2.0 for eu-dedicated until we validate a kernel-flag fix.

lia: posting traces in the ticket. initial hypothesis: new kv-cache kernel interacts poorly with certain shard sizes in eu nodes.

deploybot: NOTE: will not auto-rollback again for this release unless manual override removed. Use `deploybot override unset` to re-enable auto-mode.

maria: closing customer comm loop — customers acknowledged. one asked for postmortem when available.

jana: we'll reconvene tomorrow after root-cause analysis. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
